about: What the new package puts on a machine. scripts/ci/package_smoke.py checks every item is there after install and gone after uninstall; relay/handover/leftovers.py does the same check on the game machine. Owned by the installer (游戏-中继一): every value marked CONFIRM is a placeholder written before the installer existed - replace it with what the .iss file really does. A value that still starts with CONFIRM makes package_smoke.py stop before installing anything.
app_id: CONFIRM the Inno Setup AppId (without braces); the uninstall key is HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\{AppId}_is1, or under WOW6432Node for a 32-bit setup
env_file: CONFIRM the .env the main program reads, inside data_dir
main_process_match: CONFIRM a substring of the main program's command line, used to find and kill it
startup_log_line: CONFIRM a line the main program logs once it is up, e.g. 中继代码版本
log_file: CONFIRM the main program's log file
tasks: CONFIRM the main program's logon task name
